day.title: Write the measurable success checklist
day.objective: Complete write the measurable success checklist and produce year_one_success.csv with traceable evidence.
inputs: R0.1 one-page mission, engineering baseline and Decisions tab.
Review Day 002's output and unresolved items. If unavailable, identify the missing input rather than inventing it.
steps: Open the required inputs listed below. Check the exact revision and identify unresolved decisions for 'write the measurable success checklist'. Do not assume equipment, approval or test results exist.
Make a table with requirement ID, target, measurement method and evidence needed for height, mass, joint count, speed, step sequences and payload repetitions.
State that three alternating steps must occur twice and handling must be stationary with a 2 kg inert object for 10 supervised repetitions.
Perform this completion check and save the actual observations: Check that every target has a unit or count and no empty measurement method; distinguish target from tested result.

Save the deliverable as JacobsBaymax/requirements/day_003_year_one_success.csv. Include revision R0.2, actual date, accountable owner Faisal Farouq, your actual role, source references, results and unresolved limitations. Preserve prior evidence.

Record PASS, REWORK or BLOCKED for this day with the actual evidence reference and time spent. PASS means the stated task was evidenced; it does not release a gate, certify safety or prove the whole robot works.
acceptance: Check that every target has a unit or count and no empty measurement method; distinguish target from tested result.
The named deliverable contains actual evidence, source/revision/date/owner and limitations.
Required permissions and prior releases are evidenced; unknown, failed and unexecuted results stay visible.
